title: AtomCite: Verification and Correction of Supplied Page-Level Citations in Multi-Page Documents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models answering questions over multi-page documents are expected to cite the supporting pages, yet supplied citations are sometimes inaccurate, and current evaluations score citations at generation time or against text passages: no existing benchmark evaluates whether a system can verify and correct a page-level citation already attached to an answer. We propose AtomCite, an agentic framework that parses an answer into claims, checks each claim against the image of its cited page, and applies a deterministic repair policy. To evaluate it, we introduce DocCite, to our knowledge the first benchmark for systems that verify and correct page-level citations in document images. Built on MP-DocVQA and DUDE, it combines 928 validated injected instances with 2,468 candidate natural errors harvested from frontier- and efficiency-tier models, of which a two-annotator audit confirms 1,909 as genuine errors. translated_title: AtomCite：多页文档中所提供页级引用的验证与修正
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在回答有关多页文档的问题时，需要引用支持答案的页面，然而所提供的引用有时并不准确，且当前的评估方法只在生成时对引用进行评分，或仅针对文本段落进行评分：目前尚无基准测试能够评估系统验证和修正已附在答案上的页级引用的能力。我们提出了AtomCite，这是一个智能体框架，它将答案解析为多个声明，将每个声明与其所引用页面的图像进行核对，并应用确定性的修复策略。为了对其进行评估，我们引入了DocCite，据我们所知，这是首个针对验证和修正文档图像中页级引用的系统的基准测试。该基准基于MP-DocVQA和DUDE构建，将928个经过验证的注入实例与从前沿模型和高效模型中采集的2,468个候选自然错误相结合，其中双人标注审核确认其中1,909个为真实错误。
tldr: 提出了AtomCite智能体框架用于验证和修正多页文档中已附在答案上的页级引用，并推出了首个相关基准测试DocCite。
en_tdlr: Proposes AtomCite, an agentic framework for verifying and correcting page-level citations already attached to answers in multi-page documents, along with DocCite, the first benchmark for this task.
